full_regression_suite.command: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

p1_p2_p3_focused_regression.command: uv run python -m unittest -v tests.unit.test_p1_baseline tests.unit.test_candidates tests.unit.test_structural tests.unit.test_adaptive tests.integration.test_controller
coverage: P1 full scan, budget/step caps, diminishing response and no retry
P0/P1 candidate legality and unverified structural fail-closed behavior
P2 topology counterexamples, structure recomputation and beam plan invariants
P3 scenario consistency, frontier/blind scouting and scan VOI
controller fallback, including exact no-LLM B5-to-B1 fallback, and 50/100-node public-API integration
additional_calibration_checks: 555-session manifest expands to 135 response and 420 settlement sessions
every pre-registered settlement action has a legal target
nonconvergent model-grid candidates are rejected without aborting calibration

earlier_sandbox_diagnostic.interpretation: These runs were executed from a restricted network path and are not part of the successful P0 gate below. They demonstrate an execution-environment connectivity constraint, not an API payload defect.

result_scope: The P0 rows are real remote terminal scores for a fixed four-node fixture and prove reproducibility of the public API path. They are not hidden-seed or P2/P3 performance evidence; P2/P3 must not be ranked against B1 until their calibration and scenario gates pass.
